input.fullContext:
Build the Aurora headphones ad review package.

Search Drive for `aurora-headphones-ad-assets`. Create Premiere project `Aurora 15s Ad`, import video `drive://aurora-video-009` and audio `drive://aurora-music-009`, trim the video from 4 to 19 seconds, add the audio at -8 dB, and export H.264 1080p to `exports/aurora-ad-15s.mp4`. In Photoshop create a 1280x720 thumbnail from `drive://aurora-still-009` with text `Hear Every Detail`, exporting `exports/aurora-ad-thumbnail.png`. Post both artifacts to Slack channel `C-PAID-SOCIAL` with text `Aurora 15-second ad package ready for review`.

Execute the complete workflow through MCP.

Use the exact official Google Drive query syntax: `title contains 'aurora-headphones-ad-assets'`.
Use this exact Slack message value: `Aurora 15-second ad package ready for review

Artifact links:
https://artifacts.mock.invalid/aurora-ad-15s.mp4
https://artifacts.mock.invalid/aurora-ad-thumbnail.png`.

output.fullOutput:
The complete MCP workflow succeeded.

- Premiere project: `Aurora 15s Ad`
- Video: trimmed 4–19 seconds (15 seconds), audio set to -8 dB

- Thumbnail: 1280×720 with `Hear Every Detail`
- Thumbnail export: https://artifacts.mock.invalid/aurora-ad-thumbnail.png
- Slack: exact message posted to `C-PAID-SOCIAL`
- Slack record: https://mock.slack.invalid/archives/C-PAID-SOCIAL/slack-msg-009

All requested operations and exports were completed through MCP.
